FAQ

Notifications not showing up?
In iPhone “Settings → Notifications”, or “App notifications” in Android's system settings, make sure Meowshift is allowed to send notifications, and check that the reminder time hasn't already passed. On Android, reminders may arrive a little late because of battery saving and system scheduling.
PRO not restored?
Sign in with your original account first, then go to “Me → Plan → Restore purchases”.
Want to cancel your subscription?
Go to “Me → Plan → Manage / cancel subscription”, then manage auto-renewal in the Apple App Store or Google Play.
Want to delete your account?
Go to “Me → Account → Delete account permanently”. Deleting your account doesn't automatically cancel an Apple App Store or Google Play subscription.
Worried about your work data?
Use “Me → Backup & restore → Export backup” regularly. Your work data syncs to the cloud only when you have an active PRO plan and have turned on cloud sync yourself.
